seo.description: The areas Gelian is actively building in — overlooked value propositions under study, shaped into products, services and ventures. Not committed investments.

header.title: The areas we are building in.
header.lede: This is where Gelian's thinking becomes concrete. We are early, and we would rather show the work honestly than dress it up — so each area below sets out both the opportunity we see and what we are actually doing about it.

closingCta.title: If something you are building belongs here, we should talk.
closingCta.body: We are interested in operators, makers and partners across every one of these areas — whether you are shaping a product, a service or a venture. Tell us what you are building, and let's initiate a discussion to figure out how we can add value.
